title: Voyacher
description: Voyacher is a Qatar-based travel platform built around a single idea — purchase a digital voucher in QAR, then use it to book any service on the platform.

paragraphs: Voyacher is not a typical travel booking platform. At its core, it's a voucher ecosystem — users buy a QAR-denominated digital voucher and use that balance to book anything the platform offers.

The services — flights, Hajj & Umrah packages, healthcare travel to UK hospitals, international tours — are not separate products. They are redemption destinations. Everything flows through the voucher.
overview.quote: The hardest design problem wasn't building six service flows. It was making the voucher feel like the natural, obvious way to start — not a workaround.

process.heading: Three steps. One wallet. Any journey.
process.description: The entire platform logic lives in this loop — and the design had to make each step feel effortless.

phases.title: Buy a Voucher
phases.description: Choose a QAR denomination — from QAR 50 to QAR 5,000. Pay once. For yourself, or as a gift for someone else. The voucher lands instantly in your wallet.

phases.title: Your Wallet
phases.description: Check your balance, view active vouchers, and manage transfers — all in one place. Your voucher balance is visible across every checkout flow on the platform.

phases.title: Redeem Anywhere
phases.description: When booking any service — flights, Umrah packages, healthcare, international tours — apply your voucher balance at checkout. One tap. Done.

applications.heading: Where your voucher takes you.
applications.description: The six services on the platform are not separate products — they are the destinations your voucher unlocks.

outcome.quote: Voyacher turned six separate travel services into one wallet experience. The voucher isn't a payment method — it's the product.

deliverables.title: Voucher Wallet Dashboard
deliverables.description: Unified wallet showing balance, voucher sources, transfer capabilities, and OTP-secured transactions.

deliverables.title: Six Service Redemption Flows
deliverables.description: Flights, Hajj & Umrah, Healthcare Travel, International Tours, BNPL, and Gift & Corporate.

deliverables.title: Dev-Ready Design System
deliverables.description: 100% Figma design system covering all service flows, the wallet, and the transfer experience.
